raw: {"status":"complete","answer":{"question_id":136,"db":"MYSQL","query":"SELECT c.company_name, COUNT(v.vehicle_id) AS hazmat_vehicle_count FROM transportation.vehicle_company c JOIN transportation.vehicle v ON c.company_id = v.company_id JOIN common.vehicle_type_dict t ON v.vehicle_type_code = t.type_code JOIN common.administrative_division a ON c.area_id = a.id WHERE t.type_name = '危化品车' AND a.province_name = '湖北省' GROUP BY c.company_id, c.company_name;"},"requirements":[{"requirement":"统计湖北省各公司拥有的危化品车辆数","tables":["MYSQL:transportation.vehicle_company","MYSQL:transportation.vehicle","MYSQL:common.vehicle_type_dict","MYSQL:common.administrative_division"],"columns":["company_name","vehicle_id","type_name","province_name"]}],"assumptions":[]}
